headword: {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A lunar eclipse in which only part of the Moon passes through Earth's main shadow (umbra), darkening a section of its surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}だ。
examples.english: There is a partial lunar eclipse tonight.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}けて→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Part of the Moon appeared to be missing during the partial lunar eclipse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}ければ→良い：02350_yoi⟧、⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧だろう。
examples.english: If the weather is good, tonight's partial lunar eclipse should be clearly visible.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (partial) + ⟦{月食|げっしょく}→月食：06312_gesshoku⟧ (lunar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧: a partial lunar eclipse can be seen
- {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe a partial lunar eclipse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皆既|かいき}{月食|げっしょく}→皆既月食：17892_kaikigesshoku⟧: total lunar eclipse — the whole Moon enters Earth's shadow
- ⟦{半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}→半影月食：29536_haneigesshoku⟧: penumbral eclipse — the Moon only dims slightly
